title: The Sumerian Case System
summary: How Sumerian marks the roles of nouns without prepositions: the absolutive, ergative, genitive and adverbial cases, with a reference table.

title: Sumerian Compound Verbs
summary: How Sumerian builds verbs from a noun plus a verb such as dug₄ or ak, how they are conjugated, and a reference list of 50 compound verbs.

title: Perfective vs. Imperfective
summary: Sumerian's two verb forms, how they are built, the four stem classes, how to translate each one, and a reference list of 40 verbs.

title: Expressing Plural
summary: How plural is expressed on nouns and on verbs: the plural marker, reduplication, and the many cases where Sumerian leaves plural unmarked.

title: Subordinate Clauses
summary: How Sumerian links clauses with almost no conjunctions: the nominalising suffix -a, participles, and relative clauses.
